##Import training data

````{r read in file list of coordinates, create object of list of coordinate files}
#open specifier file
speclist.train <- read.csv("Data/Specifier.csv")
rownames(speclist.train) <- c(paste(substr(speclist.train$Genus,1,1),substr(speclist.train$Species,1,3), speclist.train$Specimen_ID ,sep = "_"))

#Create vector of coordinate files
filelist.train <-list.files(path = "Data/Coordinates", pattern = ".txt")

#Create vector of abbreviated specimen names
filelist_species <- rownames(speclist.train)

#Create array of landmark coordinate data
coords <- NULL  
setwd("C:/Users/erinm/Dropbox/Documents/PhD/Geometric_morphometrics/POSTCRANIA/Sorting-the-Mob/Astragalus/Data/Coordinates")
for (i in 1:length(filelist.train)){
  temp  <- read.morphologika(filelist.train[i]) 
  k <- dim(temp)[1] 
  coords <- rbind(coords, two.d.array(temp))}
Data.train <- arrayspecs(coords, k, 3) 
dimnames(Data.train)[[3]] <- filelist_species

setwd("C:/Users/erinm/Dropbox/Documents/PhD/Geometric_morphometrics/POSTCRANIA/Sorting-the-Mob/Astragalus")
remove(i, filelist.train, k, coords, temp, filelist_species) 
````

````{r Clean data}
Data.train <- Data.train[-c(10,18),,] #remove undesired landmarks
````

````{r Set sliding semilandmarks}
#with landmarks removed
slide <- c(28:35,38:45, 48:52)
before <- slide - 1
after <- slide + 1
curves <- cbind(before, slide, after)
remove(before, slide, after)
````

##Generalised Procrustes Analysis

````{r Generalised Procrustes Analysis----}
#Remove effects of size, rotation and translation from landmark coordinates
GPA <- gpagen(Data.train, curves = curves)
#combine transformed coordinates and specifier list}
GPA <- geomorph.data.frame(GPA, genus = speclist.train$Genus, species = speclist.train$Species, ID = speclist.train$Specimen_ID, age = speclist.train$Age, habitat = speclist.train$Habitat, complexity = speclist.train$Complexity)
````

##Symbology
````{r Symbology }
Macropus <- "#E06120"
Osphranter <- "#53f395"
Notamacropus <- "#003eff"
Wallabia <- "#F9438F"

agilis <- "#003eff"
antilopinus <- "#1f986c"
bernardus <- "#93dd4b"
bicolor <- "#F9438F"
fuliginosus <- "#E29900"
giganteus <- "#E06120"
parryi <- "#191e86"
robustus <- "#53f395"
rufogriseus <- "#47e0ff"
rufus <- "#37671d"

age <- speclist.train$Age
age <- (gsub("Juvenile", 8, age))
age <- (gsub("Subadult", 17, age))
age <- (gsub("Adult", 16, age))
age <- ifelse(is.na(age), 7, age)
age <- as.numeric(age)
age

sex <- speclist.train$Sex
sex <- (gsub("Female", 17, sex))
sex <- (gsub("Male", 15, sex))
sex <- ifelse(is.na(sex), 16, sex)
sex <- as.numeric(sex)
sex
````

##Size
````{r Boxplot}
Csize <- cbind(speclist.train[,1:7], GPA$Csize)
colnames(Csize)[8] <- "Csize"

col <- c(agilis, antilopinus, bernardus, bicolor, fuliginosus, giganteus, parryi, robustus, rufogriseus, rufus)
ggplot(Csize, aes(x = reorder(Species, Csize), y = Csize, fill = Species, group = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(varwidth = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=col) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)+
  labs(title = "Astragalus Size", x = "Species", y = "Centroid Size")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

remove(Csize, col)
````

##Principal Components Analysis
````{r Plot PC1 and PC2}
PCA <- gm.prcomp(GPA$coords)
s_PCA <- summary(PCA)

chull <- cbind(speclist.train[,1:3], PCA$x[,1:2])
colnames(chull)[4:5] <- c("PC1", "PC2")
polys <- ddply(chull, .(Species), function(chull) chull[chull(chull$PC1, chull$PC2), ])

palette <- c(agilis, antilopinus, bernardus ,bicolor ,fuliginosus ,giganteus ,parryi, robustus, rufogriseus, rufus)
palette <- palette[as.factor(speclist.train$Species)]

plot(PCA$x[,2] ~ PCA$x[,1], 
     pch=age,
     col=palette,
     xlab= paste("PC 1 (", round(s_PCA$PC.summary$Comp1[3]*100, 1), "%)", sep = ""), 
     ylab= paste("PC 2 (", round(s_PCA$PC.summary$Comp2[2]*100, 1), "%)", sep = ""), 
     main= paste("PCA of Macropod Astragalus Shape (",round(s_PCA$PC.summary$Comp2[3]*100), "% variation)"),
     asp=1, 
     cex=2.2)

polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="agilis"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="agilis"]), col = alpha(agilis, 0.2), border = agilis)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="antilopinus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="antilopinus"]), col = alpha(antilopinus, 0.2), border = antilopinus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="bernardus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="bernardus"]), col = alpha(bernardus, 0.2), border = bernardus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="bicolor"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="bicolor"]), col = alpha(bicolor, 0.2), border = bicolor)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="fuliginosus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="fuliginosus"]), col = alpha(fuliginosus, 0.2), border = fuliginosus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="giganteus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="giganteus"]), col = alpha(giganteus, 0.2), border = giganteus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="robustus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="robustus"]), col = alpha(robustus, 0.2), border = robustus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="rufogriseus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="rufogriseus"]), col = alpha(rufogriseus, 0.2), border = rufogriseus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="rufus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="rufus"]), col = alpha(rufus, 0.2), border = rufus)

abline(v=0, lty=2, col="grey50")
abline(h=0, lty=2, col="grey50")
remove(chull, polys)
```

```{r Plot PCA in 3D}
plot3d(PCA$x[,1], PCA$x[,2], PCA$x[,3],
       xlab = "PC1",
       ylab = "PC2",
       zlab = "PC3",
       type = "s",
       col = palette,
       size = 1.7,
       aspect = FALSE)
````

##Between Group PCA
````{r between group PCAs}
groups <- GPA$genus
bgPCA <- groupPCA(GPA$coords[,,], groups = groups, cv = T)

palette <- c(agilis, antilopinus, bernardus, bicolor, fuliginosus, giganteus, parryi, robustus, rufogriseus, rufus)
palette <- palette[as.factor(speclist.train$Species[])]

plot(bgPCA$Scores[,2] ~ bgPCA$Scores[,1], 
     pch=age,
     col= palette,
     xlab= paste("PC 1 (", round(bgPCA$Variance$exVar[1]*100, 1), "%)", sep = ""),
     ylab= paste("PC 2 (", round(bgPCA$Variance$exVar[2]*100, 1), "%)", sep = ""), 
     asp=1, 
     cex=2.5,
     main = paste("bg-PCA of Macropod Astragalus grouped by Genus (",round(bgPCA$Variance$cumVar[2]*100), "% variation)"))

chull <- cbind(speclist.train[,], bgPCA$Scores[,1:2])
colnames(chull)[10:11] <- c("PC1", "PC2")
polys <- ddply(chull, .(Species), function(chull) chull[chull(chull$PC1, chull$PC2), ])

polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="agilis"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="agilis"]), col = alpha(agilis, 0.2), border = agilis)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="antilopinus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="antilopinus"]), col = alpha(antilopinus, 0.2), border = antilopinus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="bernardus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="bernardus"]), col = alpha(bernardus, 0.2), border = bernardus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="bicolor"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="bicolor"]), col = alpha(bicolor, 0.2), border = bicolor)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="fuliginosus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="fuliginosus"]), col = alpha(fuliginosus, 0.2), border = fuliginosus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="giganteus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="giganteus"]), col = alpha(giganteus, 0.2), border = giganteus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="robustus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="robustus"]), col = alpha(robustus, 0.2), border = robustus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="rufogriseus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="rufogriseus"]), col = alpha(rufogriseus, 0.2), border = rufogriseus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="rufus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="rufus"]), col = alpha(rufus, 0.2), border = rufus)


abline(v=0, lty=2, col="grey50")
abline(h=0, lty=2, col="grey50")

remove(chull, polys)
````

##Allometry
```{r Allometry}
#Regress Shape ~ Csize + genus
AllomGenus1 <- procD.lm(GPA$coords[,,-c(30,79:81)] ~ GPA$Csize[-c(30,79:81)] + GPA$genus[-c(30,79:81)], logsz = TRUE, iter = 999, turbo = TRUE, RRPP = TRUE, print.progress = FALSE) #remove Wallabia c(79:81), remove N. agilis outlier #30
summary(AllomGenus1)

#Plot allometry
palette <- c(agilis, antilopinus, bernardus, fuliginosus, giganteus, parryi, robustus, rufogriseus, rufus)
palette <- palette[as.factor(GPA$species[-c(30,79:81)])]

tmp <- plotAllometry(AllomGenus1, GPA$Csize[-c(30,79:81)], 
              logsz=TRUE, 
              method = "RegScore", 
              col = palette, 
              pch= age[-c(30,79:81)], 
              cex= 2,
              main = "Astragalus Intergenera Allometry")
lmData <- data.frame(cbind(tmp$plot.args$y, tmp$plot.args$x))
lmData$Genus <- GPA$genus[-c(30,79:81)]
colnames(lmData) <- c("RegScore", "Predictor", "Genus")
slopes <- coef(lmList(RegScore ~ Predictor|Genus, data = lmData))
remove(lmData)
abline(slopes[1,1], slopes[1,2], col = Macropus)
abline(slopes[2,1], slopes[2,2], col = Notamacropus)
abline(slopes[3,1], slopes[3,2], col = Osphranter)
remove(slopes, tmp)
```

```{r unique allometries}
#Regress Shape ~ Csize * genus
AllomGenus2 <- procD.lm(GPA$coords[,,-c(30,79:81)] ~ GPA$Csize[-c(30,79:81)] * GPA$genus[-c(30,79:81)],logsz = TRUE, iter = 999, turbo = TRUE, RRPP = TRUE, print.progress = FALSE)
summary(AllomGenus2) 

#Plot allometry
tmp <- plotAllometry(AllomGenus2, GPA$Csize[-c(30,79:81)], 
              logsz=TRUE, 
              method = "RegScore", 
              col = palette, 
              pch= age[-c(30,79:81)], 
              cex= 2,
              main = "Astragalus Intergenera Allometry w. Interaction")
lmData <- data.frame(cbind(tmp$plot.args$y, tmp$plot.args$x))
lmData$Genus <- GPA$genus[-c(30,79:81)]
colnames(lmData) <- c("RegScore", "Predictor", "Genus")
slopes <- coef(lmList(RegScore ~ Predictor|Genus, data = lmData))
remove(lmData)
abline(slopes[1,1], slopes[1,2], col = Macropus)
abline(slopes[2,1], slopes[2,2], col = Notamacropus)
abline(slopes[3,1], slopes[3,2], col = Osphranter)
remove(slopes, tmp)

#Pairwise Test of Slope Differences
slopepairwise <- pairwise(AllomGenus2, fit.null = AllomGenus1, groups = GPA$genus[-c(30,79:81)], covariate = log(GPA$Csize[-c(30,79:81)])) 
summary(slopepairwise, type.test = "VC", confidence = 0.95, stat.table = TRUE)
```

##Visualising Taxonomic Shape Differences
```{r Calculating average shape}
#calculate GPA coordinates for average shape across dataset
MeanCoords <- mshape(GPA$coords)

#find closest specimen to the mean shape & read ply
findMeanSpec(GPA$coords) 
MeanMesh <- read.ply("Data/O_ruf_SAM-M27398.ply") 

#save average specimen coordinates
mean_spec_coord <- Data.train[,,which(dimnames(Data.train)[[3]]=="O_ruf_SAM-M27398")]

#Warp a reference mesh for visualisations
WarpedRefMesh <- warpRefMesh(mesh = MeanMesh, mesh.coord= mean_spec_coord,  ref= MeanCoords, color = "light grey")
remove(MeanMesh)
```

```{r Predict Shape at Mean Locations in bgPCA plot}
#Predict mean genus shape in bgPCA
tmp <- bgPCA$Scores[,1:3] 
preds <- shape.predictor(GPA$coords[,,], x= tmp, Intercept = FALSE, 
                         Macropus = c(mean(tmp[1:17, 1]), mean(tmp[1:17,2]), mean(tmp[1:17,3])), #1
                         Notamacropus = c(mean(tmp[18:34, 1]), mean(tmp[18:34,2]), mean(tmp[18:34,3])), #2
                         Osphranter = c(mean(tmp[c(35:78), 1]), mean(tmp[c(35:78),2]), mean(tmp[c(35:78),3])), #3
                         Wallabia = c(mean(tmp[79:81, 1]), mean(tmp[79:81,2]), mean(tmp[79:81,3]))) #4
#Warp reference meshes
meshlist <- list()
for (i in 1: length(preds)) {
  tempmesh <- plotRefToTarget(MeanCoords, 
                              preds[[i]], 
                              mesh = WarpedRefMesh, 
                              method="surface")
  meshlist[[i]] <- tempmesh
}
remove(tmp, i, tempmesh)
```

```{r Create warpmovie}
#Save image stacks to create warp movie of shape change between genera from different aspects
# #Macropus vs Notamacropus taxa
 warpmovie3d(meshlist[[1]], meshlist[[2]], n = 15, palindrome = F, col = "lightgrey", folder = "Analyses/GIFs/InteriorbgPCA", movie = "1_Macr_Notam")

#

 warpmovie3d(meshlist[[3]], meshlist[[1]], n = 15, palindrome = F, col = "lightgrey", folder = "Analyses/GIFs/Lateral2bgPCA", movie = "3_Osph_Macr")
# 
# #Macropus vs Wallabia
# warpmovie3d(meshlist[[1]], meshlist[[4]], n = 15, palindrome = F, col = "lightgrey", folder = "Analyses/GIFs/InteriorbgPCA", movie = "4_Macr_Wall")

```

##Visualising Allometry
```{r Osphranter}
#regress Osphranter Shape ~ Csize 
OsphAllom <- procD.lm(GPA$coords[,,c(35:63)] ~ GPA$Csize[35:63], logsz = TRUE, iter = 999, turbo = TRUE, RRPP = TRUE, print.progress = FALSE) 
summary(OsphAllom)

#Plot Allometric Regression
palette <- c(antilopinus, bernardus, robustus)
palette <- palette[as.factor(GPA$species[c(35:63)])]
OsphAllom.Plot <- plotAllometry(OsphAllom, GPA$Csize[35:63], 
              logsz=TRUE, 
              method = "PredLine", 
              col = palette, 
              pch= age[35:63], 
              cex= 2,
              main = "Astragalus Osphranter Allometry")

#Predict Min & Max Shapes along fitted allometric slope
OsphPreds <- shape.predictor(OsphAllom$GM$fitted, 
                             x= OsphAllom.Plot$PredLine, 
                             Intercept = FALSE, 
                             predmin = min(OsphAllom.Plot$PredLine), 
                             predmax = max(OsphAllom.Plot$PredLine))

#Warp Reference Mesh to Min & Max Shapes along fitted allometric slope
SmallOsph <- plotRefToTarget(mshape(GPA$coords), 
                OsphPreds$predmax,
                method = "surface",
                mesh = WarpedRefMesh)

LargeOsph <- plotRefToTarget(mshape(GPA$coords), 
                OsphPreds$predmin,
                method = "surface",
                mesh = WarpedRefMesh)

#Visualize heat mapped vector displacement between corresponding landmarks
differences <- coordinates.difference(coordinates = OsphPreds$predmax,
                                      reference = OsphPreds$predmin, type = "spherical")
procrustes.var.plot(OsphPreds$predmin, OsphPreds$predmax, col = heat.colors, col.val = differences[[1]][1:53], magnitude = 1, pt.size = 1) # 53 = n lmks
shade3d(SmallOsph, alpha = 0.6)

#Save image stack to make warp movie of allometric shape change from different aspects
# warpmovie3d(SmallOsph, LargeOsph, n = 15, palindrome = F, col = "lightgrey", folder = "Analyses/GIFs/Allometry", movie = "OsphranterAllometryPlantar")
```

```{r Notamacropus}
              main = "Astragalus Intergenera Allometry")

#Predict Min & Max Shapes along fitted allometric slope
NmacPreds <- shape.predictor(NmacAllom$GM$fitted, 
                             x= NmacAllom.Plot$PredLine, 
                             Intercept = FALSE, 
                             predmin = min(NmacAllom.Plot$PredLine), 
                             predmax = max(NmacAllom.Plot$PredLine))

#Warp Reference Mesh to Min & Max Shapes along fitted allometric slope
SmallNmac <- plotRefToTarget(mshape(GPA$coords), 
                NmacPreds$predmax,
                method = "surface",
                mesh = WarpedRefMesh)

LargeNmac <- plotRefToTarget(mshape(GPA$coords), 
                NmacPreds$predmin,
                method = "surface",
                mesh = WarpedRefMesh)

#Visualize heat mapped vector displacement between corresponding landmarks
differences <- coordinates.difference(coordinates = NmacPreds$predmax,
                                      reference = NmacPreds$predmin, type = "spherical")
procrustes.var.plot(NmacPreds$predmin, NmacPreds$predmax, col = heat.colors, col.val = differences[[1]][1:53], magnitude = 1, pt.size = 1) # 53 = n lmks
shade3d(SmallNmac, alpha = 0.6)

#Save image stack to make warp movie of allometric shape change from different aspects
# warpmovie3d(SmallNmac, LargeNmac, n = 15, palindrome = F, col = "lightgrey", folder = "Analyses/GIFs/Allometry", movie = "NotmacAllometryPlantar")
```

##Classification

```{r Create Dataframes of Predictors}
#General Procrustes Superimposition to remove size, rotation & translation from landmark coordinates
GPA <- gpagen(Data.train, curves = curves)
GPA <- geomorph.data.frame(GPA, genus = speclist.train$Genus, species = speclist.train$Species, ID = speclist.train$Specimen_ID, age = speclist.train$Age)
#Perform Principal Components Analysis
PCA <- gm.prcomp(GPA$coords) 
summary(PCA)

#Create dataframe of predictors (PC scores) and observed genus as factor vector
PCApredictors <- as.data.frame(cbind(PCA$x, GPA$genus))
PCApredictors[,1:80] <- apply(PCApredictors[,1:80], 2, as.numeric) #1:x where x is number of PCs
colnames(PCApredictors)[81] <- c("Genus")
PCApredictors$Genus <- as.factor(PCApredictors$Genus)

#Create empty matrix
IterativePCA <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = 3))
colnames(IterativePCA) <- c("variable", "Accuracy", "Kappa")
```

```{r Linear Discriminant Analysis - Optimising No. Predictors}
#run loop to save Accuracy & Kappa scores in stepwise addition of PCs as predictors 
set.seed(42)
cl <- makePSOCKcluster(5)
registerDoParallel(cl)
for (i in 2:16) { #2:x where x is number of PCs in PCA, limited to 16 in LDA to ensure the number of predictors does not exceed the within-class sample size 
ldaTune <- train(x = PCApredictors[,1:i],
                    y = PCApredictors$Genus,
                    method = "lda",
                    metric = "Accuracy",
                    prior = c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25),
                    trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", number = 1000, classProbs = TRUE))

IterativePCA <- rbind(IterativePCA, ldaTune$results[which.max(ldaTune$results$Accuracy),])} #Save Accuracy and Kappa scores in dataframe to assess optimal PCs
stopCluster(cl)

#plot Accuracy & Kappa scores to determine optimal number of PCs to include as predictors in model
IterativePCA$PCs <- c(2:16)
tmp <- IterativePCA[,c(1,3,4)]
tmp$Group <- c("Kappa")
knnPlot <- IterativePCA[,c(1,2,4)]
knnPlot$Group <- c("Accuracy")
colnames(knnPlot)[2] <- "Score"
colnames(tmp)[2] <- "Score"
knnPlot <- rbind(knnPlot, tmp)
remove(tmp)

ggplot(knnPlot, aes(x=PCs, y=Score, group = Group, color = Group)) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
```

```{r Linear Discriminant Analysis - Final Model}
# adjust predictors to optimal number of PCs and rerun final model
set.seed(42)
cl <- makePSOCKcluster(5)
registerDoParallel(cl)
ldaFIT <- train(x = PCApredictors[,1:7],
                    y = PCApredictors$Genus,
                    method = "lda",
                    metric = "Accuracy",
                    prior = c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25),
                    trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", number = 1000, classProbs = TRUE))
stopCluster(cl)

#2) Summary of final model
ldaFIT

#2) Confusion matrix of final model
confusionMatrix(ldaFIT$pred$pred, ldaFIT$pred$obs)

#clear environment
keep(Data.train, curves, speclist.train, sure = T)
```

```{r K Nearest Neighbour - Optimise No. Predictors}
#run loop to save Accuracy & Kappa scores in stepwise addition of PCs as predictors 
set.seed(42)
cl <- makePSOCKcluster(5)
registerDoParallel(cl)

for (i in 2:80) { #2:x where x is number of PCs in PCA
  knnTune <- train(x = PCApredictors[,1:i], 
                 y = PCApredictors$Genus,
                 method = "knn",
                 tuneGrid = data.frame(.k = c(2:20)), #initial tuning should be between 2:20
                 trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", number = 1000, classProbs = T))
  
IterativePCA <- rbind(IterativePCA, knnTune$results[which.max(knnTune$results$Accuracy),])} #Save Accuracy and Kappa scores in dataframe to assess optimal PCs
stopCluster(cl)

#plot Accuracy & Kappa scores to determine optimal number of PCs to include as predictors in model
IterativePCA$PCs <- c(2:80)
tmp <- IterativePCA[,c(1,3,4)]
tmp$Group <- c("Kappa")
knnPlot <- IterativePCA[,c(1,2,4)]
knnPlot$Group <- c("Accuracy")
colnames(knnPlot)[2] <- "Score"
colnames(tmp)[2] <- "Score"
knnPlot <- rbind(knnPlot, tmp)
remove(tmp)

ggplot(knnPlot, aes(x=PCs, y=Score, group = Group, color = Group)) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
```

```{r KNN - Tune Final Model}

                 y = PCApredictors$Genus,
                 method = "knn",
                 tuneGrid = data.frame(.k = c(11)), #initial tuning should be between 2:20
                 trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", number = 1000, classProbs = T))
stopCluster(cl)

#Plot Accuracy score over k to determine optimal value for k
```

```{r Random Forest - Optimise No. Predictors}
#run loop to save Accuracy & Kappa scores in stepwise addition of PCs as predictors 
set.seed(42)
cl <- makePSOCKcluster(5)
registerDoParallel(cl)

for (i in 2:80) { #2:x where x is number of PCs in PCA
   rfTune <- train(x = PCApredictors[,1:i],
                   y = PCApredictors$Genus,
                   method = "rf",
                   metric = "Accuracy",
                   tuneGrid = data.frame(.mtry = c(2:(i-1))), #tune mtry on 2:i-1 no. of predictors. i should not exceed total no. predictors in model
                   trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", number = 1000, classProbs = TRUE))
    
IterativePCA <- rbind(IterativePCA, rfTune$results[which.max(rfTune$results$Accuracy),])} #Save Accuracy and Kappa scores in dataframe to assess optimal PCs

#plot Accuracy & Kappa scores to determine optimal number of PCs to include as predictors in model
IterativePCA$PC <- c(2:80)
tmp <- IterativePCA[,c(1,3,4)]
tmp$Group <- c("Kappa")
RFplot <- IterativePCA[,c(1,2,4)]
RFplot$Group <- c("Accuracy")
colnames(RFplot)[2] <- "Score"
colnames(tmp)[2] <- "Score"
RFplot <- rbind(RFplot, tmp)
remove(tmp)

ggplot(RFplot, aes(x=PC, y=Score, group = Group, color = Group)) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
```
